name: A Meal Served Cold

aliases: who gives a meal served cold
who wants the chilled basilisk haunch
faq.answer: Angus Stern seeks the chilled meat. He works inside the Blue Recluse tavern in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.
He stays inside the Blue Recluse, a popular inn and tavern located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
You hunt a Cold Eye Basilisk to cut a chilled haunch from the creature.
You must survive the hunt and bring the chilled cut straight back without releasing your spirit.
faq.q: What happens if you fall during the hunt?

sections.body: Angus Stern stays by the hearth of the Blue Recluse in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. He needs a cold eye basilisk hunted down and a chilled basilisk haunch brought directly to his kitchen. The beast will not yield the cut easily, and the venture demands you return alive without falling in the wild.
sections.title: The Cook's Request

summary: Angus Stern in the Blue Recluse has sent you into the wilds for an unusual culinary prize. You must track down a cold eye basilisk and carve out a chilled haunch for the Stormwind cook. One slip in the field could ruin everything, for the kitchen waits on your safe return.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Meal Served Cold
